title: The one-shot barrier, used twice
notes: Round one starts well: T3 is the third to arrive and opens b. But count never goes back to 0, so in round two it goes 4, 5, 6 and nobody is ever the third to arrive. T1 goes on, comes round and waits at b for one step: T2, passing the turnstile of round one, lets it through. T1 goes on in round two before T3 has even reached the turnstile of round one.
